termZh: 轮播（幻灯片放映或图像旋转器）
definitionZh: 轮播通过顺序显示一张或多张幻灯片的子集来呈现一组项目（称为幻灯片）。通常，一次显示一张幻灯片，用户可以激活下一张或上一张幻灯片控件，该控件隐藏当前幻灯片并将下一张或上一张幻灯片“旋转”到视图中。在一些实现中，旋转在页面加载时自动开始，并且也可以在所有幻灯片显示完毕后自动停止。虽然幻灯片可以包含任何类型的内容，但每张幻灯片仅包含单个图像的图像轮播很常见。
sourceDefinition: A carousel presents a set of items, referred to as slides, by sequentially displaying a subset of one or more slides. Typically, one slide is displayed at a time, and users can activate a next or previous slide control that hides the current slide and "rotates" the next or previous slide into view. In some implementations, rotation automatically starts when the page loads, and it may also automatically stop once all the slides have been displayed. While a slide may contain any type of content, image carousels where each slide contains nothing more than a single image are common.
